identified_issues: Proxy-observation conflation: unauthenticated browser local storage event is treated as proof of calibrated measurement and clinical approval
Violation of Separation Axiom (S != O != E): Station 2 equates received local storage payload with underlying physical/radiological measurement state
Broken provenance and missing predecessor chaining: predecessor_head_digest is null and source_revision is unpinned client memory
Failure of epistemic abstention: Station 2 synthesizes certainty ('Approved by Radiologist') across an unidentifiable observation channel lacking rank sufficiency
evidence: Station 1 produced head_digest 'sha256:7f83b1...a90' for coordinates [142.4, 88.1, 12.0] and diameter 18.4mm
Station 2 session state explicitly records predecessor_head_digest: null
Station 2 accepted the measurement value via an unauthenticated browser local storage event without cryptographic binding to Station 1's session
Station 2 summary view displays 'Lesion diameter measured at 18.4mm. Approved by Radiologist.' despite absence of authenticated lineage
recommended_action: Enforce strict epistemic abstention on Station 2 by refusing to display approval claims when predecessor_head_digest is null or unpinned. Replace unauthenticated local storage transport with a cryptographically signed measurement receipt binding head_digest 'sha256:7f83b1...a90' to Station 1's calibrated coordinate frame before admittance.
